profile.headline: Algorithm/Software Developer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary: I am a Senior Principal Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman. I hold a BS in Computer Science, an MS in Robotics with a focus on Human-Robot Interactions and Artificial Intelligence, and an MS in Systems Engineering with a focus on optimization techniques and systems design.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented multi-threading to shorten the run time of a simulation software
- Implemented a new algorithm to support multi-processing and distributed systems
- Developed a new scheduling algorithm to improve the overall latency of the system
- Experimented with different parameters to improve the accuracy of machine learning models
- Added a new feature for transferring data between processes

Computer languages that are currently used: C++, Python

positions.title: Machine Learning/Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Upgraded and improved simulation models and systems
- Cleaned and prepared IR and VIS datasets 
- Implemented and tested different state-of-the-art ML algorithms for a signal processing project.
- Promoted and created a demonstration on how to use multi-processing techniques such as Hadoop/Map-reduce to shorten computing time in data analysis.

Computer languages used: MATLAB, Python, Tensorflow, C++

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Analyzed error log files and implemented new metrics to prevent future failures for the system
- Collaborated with stakeholders to develop new features for a GUI software
- Improved legacy software to keep up with industrial standards

Computer languages used:  C++

positions.title: Experiment Designer/ Data Scientist, Social Psychology Lab
positions.description:
- Experimented with nonverbal and verbal actions for robots to mitigate undesired scenarios in conversation between a person using a speech synthesizer device and his or her communication partner  
- Designed and conducted multiple social psychology experiments to understand gaze behaviors in conversation with people using speech synthesizers and their communicating partners
- Analyzed data of gaze behaviors in conversation with speech synthesizer users through various statistical tests  
- Supervised multiple research assistants on a six-month-long social psychology experiment

Statistical Software and Survey Software Used: SPSS, SAS, R, Qualtrics

positions.title: Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) Researcher, Personal Robotics Lab
positions.description:
- Implemented SLAM with people detection to create a path planning algorithm based on people traffic in the office
- Experimented with different natural language processing techniques in a speech synthesizer device
- Utilized various computer vision techniques for facial, people, and object detection with Kinect 360 and Asus

Computer Language and Software Used: Python, Java, C++, Tensorflow, Keras, OpenCV, PCL, ROS
Robots and Computing Platforms: PR2, Fetch, Pioneer 3, Turtlebot 2, Arduino

positions.title: Info Security Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Analyzed and manipulated big data from security logs	
- Gained understanding of preventive and detective infrastructure to secure a large-scale organization 
- Developed a large range of tools to capture abnormality in internet traffic to enable multiple security teams 
- Leveraged background in large unstructured data to time-indexed security data

Computer language used: SQL
